action.name: Multiattack
entries: The mummy makes two Rotting Fist attacks and uses Dreadful Glare.

action.name: Rotting Fist
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 5}, reach 5 ft. {@h}8 ({@damage 1d10 + 3}) Bludgeoning damage plus 10 ({@damage 3d6}) Necrotic damage. If the target is a creature, it is cursed. While cursed, the target can't regain {@variantrule Hit Points|SRD52}, its {@variantrule Hit Points|SRD52|Hit Point} maximum doesn't return to normal when finishing a {@variantrule Long Rest|SRD52}, and its {@variantrule Hit Points|SRD52|Hit Point} maximum decreases by 10 ({@dice 3d6}) every 24 hours that elapse. A creature dies and turns to dust if reduced to 0 {@variantrule Hit Points|SRD52} by this attack.

action.name: Dreadful Glare
entries: {@actSave wis} {@dc 11}, one creature the mummy can see within 60 feet. {@actSaveFail} The target has the {@condition Frightened|SRD52} condition until the end of the mummy's next turn. {@actSaveSuccess} The target is immune to this mummy's Dreadful Glare for 24 hours.

Common mummies are the remains of priests, nobles, or champions of faith that underwent magical burial rites. Some are preserved through processes using linen wrappings or clay, but others are preserved by peat bogs, ice, magic, or other means.
Roll on or choose a result from the Mummy Resurrections table to determine why a mummy has returned from the dead.

entries.caption: Mummy Resurrections
rows: Defend a holy site it was created to protect.
Obey the summons of a mummy lord.
Oppose an enemy who has returned to life.
Protect its descendants from an ancient threat.
Punish the progeny of those who cursed it.
Reclaim treasures robbed from its crypt.
Serve whoever speaks the prayer on its tomb.
Slay anyone who sets eyes on it.

entries: Rule 7: Before opening a sarcophagus, light a torch.
